fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with a known sensitizing molecular alteration for which a Food and Drug Administration (FDA)-approved targeted therapy for NSCLC exists (e.g., EGFR, ALK, ROS1, BRAF, RET, NTRK, KRAS, HER2, and MET sensitizing mutations), must have previously received at least one of the approved therapy(s).

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must not have received any palliative radiation therapy within 14 days (or palliative bone radiation therapy within 7 days) prior to randomization

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must not have undergone major surgery within 28 days prior to randomization...
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Surgical washout windows are judgment-based procedure rules.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must not have an active autoimmune disease that has required systemic treatment within 730 days prior to randomization...
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex washout and clinical rule regarding autoimmune disease history.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must not have any grade III/IV cardiac disease as defined by the New York Heart Association criteria...
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: NYHA functional class criteria are subjective clinical evaluations.
